name: Toolmaster
body:
Your religious training, and the blessings of your god, increase your ability to get the most out of your tools.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Artifice, Construct or Toil Domain

Benefit(s): When using a set of masterwork tools, you gain a +4 bonus to your Craft checks.

Normal: Masterwork tools normally add a +2 bonus to your Craft skill checks.
